Overwhelming Surprise - Are We Ready? Sunday On It's Way!

In Episode 231 we recap on our discussions with Douglas Wilson and Lennox Kalifungwa and bring together what is happening around the world, and especially in the the US. Prophecy is unfolding before our eyes. The time is now for the people of God to wake up and get ready, get ready, get ready otherwise it will come down on us as an overwhelming surprise.
